packageRules.description: Hold TypeScript at 6.x: typescript-eslint's supported peer range is '>=4.8.4 <6.1.0', and eslint crashes under the native TS 7 compiler ('Cannot read properties of undefined (reading Cjs)'). Revisit when typescript-eslint supports TypeScript 7.

Hold jsdom at 29.x: jsdom 30 absolutizes relative lengths in getComputedStyle (2rem resolves to 32px, -0.025em to -0.4px), so every design-system toHaveStyle assertion written in rem/em fails. Revisit once those assertions stop comparing against computed style.

Hold apps/web Vite at 8.0.x: 8.1.x (Rolldown) drops top-level bindings in the Storybook production build, breaking Chromatic with 'ReferenceError: ... is not defined' (MSW checkGlobals). See https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/issues/33789. Revisit when Storybook supports Vite 8/Rolldown.

Hold the editor's Vite at 7.x: electron-vite 5's supported peer range is '^5 || ^6 || ^7', and under Vite 8 the preload build stops externalizing 'electron' — the npm package's binary-path shim gets bundled, requires child_process, and a sandboxed preload cannot load it, so the renderer starts without editorAPI and every e2e locator times out on a blank window. Revisit when electron-vite supports Vite 8.

Hold the editor's @vitejs/plugin-react at 5.x: v6 imports the 'vite/internal' subpath that only exists in Vite 8, and the editor's Vite is held at 7.x for electron-vite (see the rule above). The two move together — lift both when electron-vite supports Vite 8.
